8602: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Workstation Seat
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-8602-endurance-wall-mount-work-station-seat
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/room-furnishings/endurance-workstation-seat/
Spec sheet: 8602
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Workstation Seat – 8602
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Wall Mounted Work Station Seat - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 8602
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Wall Seat That Pairs with the Workstation Desk or Works as a Shelf
Current subtitle: Cortech 8602 Endurance Wall Mount Workstation Seat, Endurance Wall Mount Workstation Dual Station Small Desk
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Workstation Seat is a space-saving seat for compact cells, patient rooms, and other secure settings. It mounts directly to the wall and can be paired with the Endurance Workstation Desk or used on its own as a seat or shelf.
The seat is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components, and is static load tested to 2,000 lbs. It bolts to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice, and it is rated for outdoor use.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Use: Pairs with the Endurance Workstation Desk (8601) or other desks, or can be used as a shelf
Dimensions: 18”W×18”D×11”H
Weight: 15 lbs
Load Testing: 2,000 lb static load tested
Mounting: Bolts to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
8602 – Workstation Seat: 18”W×18”D×11”H, 15 lbs; desk sold separately
Installation and Options
Wall Mounting: Bolt to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice
[H2] Applications
The Workstation Seat suits small rooms where seating must be fixed to the wall and floor space is limited.
Typical applications include:
Cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Compact rooms and study areas where floor space is limited
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (54 characters): Cortech Endurance Workstation Seat - 8602 at Anchortex
Meta description (154 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Workstation Seat. A one-piece molded wall seat that pairs with the workstation desk or works as a shelf, rated for outdoor use.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out "One-Piece Rotationally Molded" and "Model," and wrote "Workstation" as one word, as Cortech does.
Variant name: your variant is named "8602 - Workstation Desk." This page sells the seat. Would you like it renamed "8602 - Workstation Seat"?
Subtitle: your current subtitle also calls it a "Dual Station Small Desk." Cortech calls it a seat that can also be used as a shelf, so I left "desk" out.
Weight: your variant is set to 15 lbs, which matches the Cortech spec sheet.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I added it.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says this seat is rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has four images. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
